ruleDefinitions.name: Potential Credential Dumping Via WER - Application
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects Windows error reporting event where the process that crashed is lsass. This could be the cause of an intentional crash by techniques such as Lsass-Shtinkering to dump credential Note: Unmapped fields: Provider_Name, AppName, ExceptionCode

sequences.query: (Provider_Name = "Application\ Error" AND event_id = 1000 AND AppName = "lsass\.exe" AND ExceptionCode = "c0000001")
